tags.feature: Linux edition! That’s right, you can now play [url=https://store.steampowered.net/app/404960]The Way of Life: DEFINITIVE EDITION[/url]  on your Linux computer!

tags.bug: Settings: the VSync options are now properly saved, and will not reset on game start;
Windowed mode: it should now work properly and on every resolution;
Sounds: added missing footsteps sound in a few locations;
Texts: fixed a few typos;
Tutorial: the symbols on the Library Keys are now displaying correctly when picked up;

Indicators on each game door now show which level endings have been completed, so it’s easier to spot from the center of the hub which levels you haven’t played yet and how many endings you are missing.

notes.title: SPRING RENOVATION UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/d91c4bb1b51e06ecd762da45d5c2ca9194a4e3ff.png[/img]

Hello!

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION[/url] has been released. It is now time to give some love to the Free Edition as well! The previous version was two years old: with the Spring Renovation Update this small fragment of the full game will look like the one in the DEFINITIVE EDITION.
In addition you can now play the game in three new languages: French, German and Russian. 

If you have played the Free Edition before and you are still waiting to play the DEFINITIVE EDITION, we suggest you play the game again and experience all the improvements made in the past two years.

Thanks for your support, we hope to see you again in the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/404960/The_Way_of_Life_DEFINITIVE_EDITION/]DEFINITIVE EDITION![/url]

notes.title: VERSION 2.0 UPDATED!
notes.content:
Hi guys, we have finally updated the Free Edition of the game with lots of improvements and fixes.  


Here are the full patch notes for the 2.0 update released on November the 21st, 2016.


[list]
    [*]We overhauled the tutorial section to clearly reflect all the changes we made in the new update. All in all, the tutorial should be more clear and more useful than the previous one.
    [*]A new mechanic has been added to the game: in-game tips. Whenever you feel lost or in doubt on what to do next, by pressing a key (Q on Keyboard, B on gamepad)  you’ll receive a small tip contextualized as one of the character thoughts. This should hopefully make the game easier to understand. 
    [*]Made a lot of improvements to the character controller: all movements should now be smoother and overall more pleasant.
    [*]Solved a bug where the cursor would not be locked in the game screen after switching to desktop and switching back in.  
    [*]Changed the Oldman character movement system as some people would get motion sickness. The new system should fix the issue, retaining at the same time the same simulation of the old age view. 
    [*]Solved a game breaking bug in the Positive Dream Kid section where landing on roofs would not work properly. 
    [*]Solved a game breaking bug in the money gathering section in the Positive Dream Adult level where collision with NPCs would send the player flying out of the game world. 
    [*]Sped up some sections of the game which were too long and boring.
    [*]General bugfixing and frame rate improvement.
    [*]Major improvements to the user experience.
    [*]All texts have been overhauled and spelling mistakes have been fixed.
[/list] 

Overall, we focused on making the game much more enjoyable by listening to all of your feedbacks. We hope you’ll enjoy the new update and the new mechanics!

As always we are listening to all of your messages and feedbacks, so if you find bugs or if you have some ideas on how you would improve the game, let us know in the comments or in reviews, we do read them all one by one.

notes.title: CROWDFUNDING CAMPAIGN & MINOR UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]Hello friends!
Here's a new update for you: we added few things, fixed minor bugs and the combat mechanic in the Adult Conflict level has been overhauled.

[b]
[url=https://www.eppela.com/projects/5016-the-way-of-life?locale=en] The crowdfunding campagin [/url] for the full version is going pretty well! [/b]

We raised more than 2000€ in few days and now we need just 3000 € to fulfill the campaign! Postepay crowd (our sponsor) will help us with 5000€ to complete the campaign so that you’ll be able to enjoy the final version.

[b]Your support means everything to us, please help us to complete the game :)[/b]

Remember, with only 5 euros you will be able to preorder the “Definitive Edition” of the game (instead of 10 euros, release price).

thank you as always,
Cybercoconut team[/h1]

notes.title: New Nightmare levels! & Crowdfunding campaign
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Friends! 
Today we release an update that will allow you to play the [b]Nightmare levels![/b] 
Please don’t forget that, as the last time, this is an alpha version, so some of you may experience some problems. 

Play the new content and let us know if you liked it! [b]As always we appreciate all kinds of feedback. [/b]

For those who are more passionate about our work the big news is the official start of our[b] crowdfunding campaign[/b] in order to sustain The Way of Life Definitive Edition. It has just been approved by the community on greenlight! 
Play the new levels if you still haven’t got the idea of how the game is gonna be. This is why we put this experiences in alpha version. To allow you all to decide if you like The Way of Life and you may want to fund it!

[b]
Through our website you will be able to donate with paypal: 
http://thewayoflife.it/?lang=en

otherwise here is the official link of the crowdfunding campaign:
http://www.eppela.com/projects/5016-the-way-of-life?locale=en

All the news about the crowdfunding campaign will be posted on our facebook page: 
https://www.facebook.com/The-Way-of-Life-438857072990892/
[/b]

If you ever need any assistance or doubt don’t hesitate to contact us, we will answer and if needed, we will also publish some FAQ/Tutorials.

As always we thank you for your support, if you love TWL this is the best moment not only to buy it with a discount, but also to get it in its complete and most beautiful version. Hurry up as long as the campaign is ongoing![/h1]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We are happy to announce we have released a new update, the first in what we hope to be a long list! The prototype version of the game will always be available as demo. We are working really hard to bring you our vision of The Way of Life. The game as we designed it will be way bigger than what we can currently achieve without funds or external helps, so we are going to start a crowdfunding campaign on September. After this update, the next major one will be available to you at the beginning of the campaign: we hope that you'll try out the levels and you’ll be able to decide if our game is worth your money. Obviously, there is still a long way to go, so the levels we are releasing are still to be considered as alpha, missing content like music and sound fx and technical features, like optimization, controller support, a more detailed setting menu and so on.

The quality of the final game will be of course proportional to the result of the campaign.

This new update features 3 new levels and a whole new Experience. We hope you’ll have a fun time playing the new content.

Since the game is still very early in development, we are looking forward every possible feedback.

This game wouldn’t have left his prototypal stage if it wasn’t for your overwhelming support and feedback, so once again, we would like to thank every single one of you, you guys rocks!

The Way of Life team

[url=https://www.facebook.com/438857072990892/photos/a.443195845890348.1073741828.438857072990892/472801399596459/?type=1&theater ] Check the facebook page! [/url]

notes.title: The Way of Life is in Early Access!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello my friends,
I'm happy to announce that our latest game is now available in early access!

We've decided to include the first three levels for FREE and then add the levels during the development.

the complete version will include:

- 20+ levels
- Oculus rift mode
- Multiplayer mode
- Emoticons and cards

and much more! [/h1]
[b]Stay tuned for more updates.	[/b]
